image_to_video.notes: A single source image acts as the starting frame.

first_frame.notes: Image-to-video source image is the opening frame.

last_frame.notes: No last-frame interpolation control is documented for grok-imagine-video-1.5.

first_last_frame.notes: No first+last interpolation mode is documented.

reference_to_video.notes: Reference images and/or reference voices guide a newly composed scene without locking frame 0.

reference_video.notes: Reference-to-video accepts image references, not motion-video references. Video is handled by separate xAI edit/extend workflows.

reference_audio_preset_voice.notes: Up to 3 preset voice_id references in reference-to-video.

reference_audio_custom.notes: User-supplied voice/audio references are available only to trusted partners on request; fail closed unless account capability is verified.

native_audio.notes: Generated videos include audio by default; generate_audio=false requests silence.

dialogue_lipsync.notes: Native audiovisual speech is supported, but exact speech/lipsync should be production-QC'd.

native_multi_shot.notes: No dedicated provider-native shot/timestamp contract is documented; prefer logical independent shots for repairability.

video_edit.notes: Current official editing examples use companion model grok-imagine-video.

video_extend.notes: Current official extension examples use companion model grok-imagine-video.

files_api_input.notes: Start and reference images may use URL, base64 data URI or xAI file_id.

native_1080p_t2v_i2v.notes: 1080p is supported for text-to-video and image-to-video.

notes: Only one video generation mode may be active per request.
A start-frame image (image-to-video) cannot be combined with reference-to-video inputs.
Reference-to-video images guide people/objects/clothing/style but do not lock the first frame.

For image-to-video, output defaults to the input image aspect ratio. Supplying aspect_ratio overrides it and may stretch the source image; production should pre-normalize the Start Frame instead of relying on provider stretching.
Generated audio is enabled by default unless generate_audio=false.

bestFor: character/product/place consistency via up to 7 image references
reference-driven product placement and character storytelling
knownRisks: Start Frame and Reference-to-Video cannot be combined in one request.
Video reference is not a Reference-to-Video input for 1.5; motion/camera video references require derivation or another provider/workflow.
Custom uploaded voice references require a trusted-partner entitlement and must not be assumed available.
No last-frame or first+last-frame control is documented.
Overriding aspect ratio on an image-to-video request may stretch the Start Frame.

notes: duration is directly controllable from 1 to 15 seconds.
No dedicated official native multi-shot API contract is documented. Prefer independent logical shots in production.
Use companion model grok-imagine-video for xAI edit/extend workflows.
